recommendation: Keep the commit as-is. No further FHIR-48325 core change is needed unless a future work-group decision explicitly changes OperationDefinition.parameter.binding valueSet requirements for descriptive bindings.
issue_request: FHIR-48325 was Applied/Persuasive with Modification for R6. It requested a way for ElementDefinition bindings to provide descriptive guidance when no valueSet is present, with the final resolution adding BindingStrength descriptive, requiring valueSet omission when that strength is used, and updating terminology guidance.
initial_application: Commit 4eefbe2059 added the descriptive strength to ElementDefinition.binding.strength, added the ElementDefinition FHIRPath invariant, added the terminology spreadsheet row, and later terminology-page text also contained the definition. The checked-in source/operationdefinition/codesystem-binding-strength.xml copy still lacked the descriptive concept, and the invariant message contained a typo.
additional_context: January 2025 FHIR-I and Vocabulary/TI minutes confirm the work group chose to extend BindingStrength because the normative ElementDefinition.binding.strength cardinality could not be loosened. source/fhir.ini lists OperationDefinition as an active resource, so the operationdefinition CodeSystem XML is in current build scope. FHIR-46350 and FHIR-48479 were inspected as related binding-policy/page-organization context but are separate decisions.
reconciliation: Published a source-changing commit that adds the descriptive concept and approved definition to source/operationdefinition/codesystem-binding-strength.xml and fixes the ElementDefinition invariant message typo from "ve" to "be" while preserving the existing FHIRPath expression.
source_changes: source/operationdefinition/codesystem-binding-strength.xml: added the descriptive BindingStrength concept with the approved definition.
source/datatypes/elementdefinition.xml: corrected the human-readable invariant message for descriptive bindings; the FHIRPath invariant was already correct.

related_jiras.note: Discussed adjacent to FHIR-48325 in January 2025 minutes because both govern primary/additional binding policy, but its applied resolution concerns separate additional-binding consistency guidance.
Later terminology-page reorganization kept descriptive binding-strength guidance in the combined bindings table, but it is a separate page-organization issue.
